reason: 该插件的主要面向用户用途是 DSH 的插件治理：通过设置面板提供插件列表与运行状态，并在此基础上完成热启停、安装/卸载及更新；并提供 `plugin_audit` 对已安装插件进行清单与代码层面的体检与风险标记，属于通用实用型的插件运维管理工具。

summaries.zh: DSH 插件管家在设置面板中管理已安装插件，支持审计、列表展示、热启停，并提供插件的安装、卸载与版本更新操作。
summaries.en: DSH Plugin Doctor provides plugin management in the settings panel, including auditing, listing, hot enable/disable, and install/uninstall/version update actions.

capabilities: Audits installed plugins via manifest, patch, static code, and supply-chain checks.
Lists plugin runtime/load status and updates plugin metadata in profile configuration.
Provides hot enable/disable, install, uninstall, and update operations through host tooling and package manager commands.
Reads and writes plugin configuration/patch files to persist state changes.
